sources.snippet: The fine-tuning process involved 25,197 of Computer-9's own conversational turns, which were rigorously filtered and subjected to a logic check. These turns were length- and surprisal-matched across bins, with the loss specifically calculated on Model C's contributions.

sources.title: Run Computer-1 API (Easy Deployment & Flat-Rate Pricing)
sources.snippet: Developed by cosmicoptima, it is part of a unique 'living document' project, designed to function as an 'interpreter' that analyzes stories and philosophies feelings. This model excels at structured analysis and shared figuring, offering a distinct conversational persona that is inward and honest, rather than a general-purpose chatbot.
